_provenance.status: Every profile below is PENDING. None has passed E-PROF (plan 7.4).
_provenance.consequence: Production defaults to explicit user selection. Automatic classification stays disabled until a profile is VALIDATED with zero held-out misidentifications and a bounded upper confidence limit in every supported stratum.
_provenance.supported_client_size_px: Profiles are fitted for a 1280x720 CLIENT area. A different viewport size abstains rather than rescaling.

provenance.source: seven owner-supplied crops of the live arrow across dirt, grass, water and pale terrain, measured 2026-08-28
provenance.note: The band is deliberately LOOSE and generates proposals only. On grass the arrow's green chromaticity is 0.518 and the grass behind it is 0.520, so no colour rule can separate them - local contrast, the two-notch topology and the rest of the score do that (DECISIONS.md D-024). Area bounds span 0.04% to 46% of the canonical frame because the arrow fills a quarter of the view when the player stands under it. E-PROF has not been run.
